text: Daughter Ella, 10. 39.3 temp. She's breathing really fast and it looks like hard work for her, you can see it pulling in under her ribs and there's a sort of grunt with some breaths. She hasn't had a wee since this morning, so 12+ hours now. Sick once earlier but she's kept drinks down after that. I've been up with her two nights running and I'm not sure I'm thinking straight, please tell me what to do.
